## Description

Hold a risky ETF when it is above a long moving average and reduce exposure or move to defensive assets below it.

## Where it may fit

Long-cycle trends and extended bear markets; may exit/re-enter late during fast reversals.

## Vehicles

Equity-index ETFs, leveraged ETFs with explicit risk limits, tactical allocation portfolios.

## Required data

Monthly total-return prices; long moving average; defensive proxy; slippage/tax assumptions.

## Caveats

A filter can reduce some drawdowns but also miss rebounds; does not make a leveraged ETF safe.
